name: I Forgot Who My Friends Are
author: Joe
bootlegger: The Amnesiac might be any character type.
The Amnesiac starts knowing which character type they are. They learn this truthfully, even if drunk, poisoned, and/or the Vortox is in play.
If the Amnesiac is a demon; the storyteller announces this at the start of day one, and the Amnesiac might learn clues about their ability at night.
The Alchemist might have the Amnesiac ability.
If the Philosopher chooses Amnesiac and an evil Amnesiac is in play, the Amnesiac does not become drunk.
